title: Helpful question handling by sales staff
summary: Reviews mainly praise sales and dealer staff for answering questions clearly, thoroughly, and efficiently, while one fragment only notes that more questions arose after taking the car home.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe staff as helpful, clear, and diligent in answering questions, including follow-up and checking with colleagues when needed.

undetermined.summary: One undetermined fragment mentions having more questions after getting the car home without enough detail to judge the experience.

limitations: The sample is small, so the examples are insufficient to assess broader patterns beyond helpful question answering.
The undetermined fragment does not explain whether the extra questions were resolved or whether they reflect a positive or negative experience.
